sources.quote: 8.3.3.3 Any change to a characteristic designated special, to its control method or to its sampling frequency needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.

| 30 | Material properties | Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat | Quarantine heat, notify Supplier Quality Engineer |
Cut the tensile test from 1 specimen per heat to 1 per 3 heats.

findings.why: The change cuts the sampling frequency of the tensile test that controls SC-01, a special characteristic, in control plan CP-BR220-R3 step 30. CSR-STL-2026-02 8.3.3.3 requires written Stellantis approval before a change to a special characteristic's sampling frequency. Nothing in the documents already covers it. The documents don't list the programs that BR-220 is delivered for, so confirm that BR-220 belongs to Annex A programs STL-Torino-27 or STL-Torino-31. The argument that there has never been a tensile failure does not replace the approval.
